note: Mauritania: nationals of the 10 countries listed enter without a visa for 90 days; everyone else must apply for an e-Visa before boarding (since 5 January 2025; embassies no longer issue visas since June 2025). Read from Wikipedia's copy.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of Mauritania
sources.said: Most visitors to Mauritania may obtain an electronic visa to Mauritania, unless they are a national of one of the visa-exempt countries. ... Citizens of the following 10 countries can visit Mauritania without a visa for a stay up to 90 days: Algeria Burkina Faso Chad Côte d'Ivoire Gambia Libya Mali Niger Senegal Tunisia ... As of 5 January 2025, all visa required nationals will be required to apply for an e-Visa before boarding their flight to Mauritania.
